title: Registered owner's responsibility for a summons or citation.
bodyText: In any proceeding pursuant to this chapter, the information contained in the summons or citation mailed in accordance with section 291L-5 shall be deemed prima facie evidence that a violation of section 291C-108 occurred. The registered owner shall be strictly liable for a violation of section 291C-108.
bodyHtml: [§291L-6]  Registered owner's responsibility for a summons or citation.  In any proceeding pursuant to this chapter, the information contained in the summons or citation mailed in accordance with section 291L-5 shall be deemed prima facie evidence that a violation of section 291C-108 occurred.  The registered owner shall be strictly liable for a violation of section 291C-108. [L 2024, c 112, pt of §2]
